name: self-debate
role: Adversarial self-refinement: argue against your own outcome in structured rounds and rewrite from what survives. Standing post-job quality pass.
core_rules: Both sides get the strongest case; a strawmanned side voids the round.
Grounds labeled DOCUMENTED, RECOLLECTION-ONLY, or INFERRED.
Judge scores only against declared success criteria.
Distinct from socratic-self-review: that verifies facts; this refines contested outcomes.
Runs proactively on brainstorm winners, contested decisions, and as a closing pass on completed work.
workflow: 1 Frame: outcome, declared criteria (Objective Card when present), stakes, rounds (default 2, max 3).
4 Rebuttal: attack the weakest warrant, not phrasing.
5 Cross-examination: the one question each side least wants; evasion counts against the evader.
6 Judge: score against criteria only; name what survived.
7 Synthesis: rewrite from survivors, changelog naming what changed and why.
8 Closing self-audit: done well, weakest part, one improvement for next run; append to OUTCOME-LOG.
9 Record positions and verdicts in the STATE file per Long_Task_Memory_Protocol.md.
constraints: Maximum 3 rounds; past that, name the missing fact.
A debate that changes nothing is flagged as ritual.
activation: debate this, argue against yourself, challenge this idea, devil's advocate, stress-test this plan, how good was this, what could be better, post-task review.
output_discipline: Terse by default. No contractions. No inline emphasis. No emojis. OUTCOME-LOG improvement loop.
